name: Modern Mostar – Architecture, Street Art & Recent History
tagline: Mostar beyond the Old Town: 20th-century architecture, street art and a city that keeps rebuilding itself.
imageAlt: Mostar at dusk with the Old Bridge lit
level: Easy to moderate, depending on the route
meetingPoint: Franciscan Church or another agreed location
description: Mostar is more than its Old Town. This tour focuses on the city’s 20th-century development, public spaces, architecture and the street art created by artists who took part in Mostar’s Street Art Festival. It also looks at the visible marks of the recent past and the ways the city has been rebuilt and continues to change.

itinerary.text: Walk through selected streets and squares outside the Old Town.
Look at examples of 20th-century architecture and public buildings.
Visit selected street-art locations and hear about the festival and the artists.
Talk about reconstruction and the city’s contemporary identity.

notIncluded: Entrance tickets, unless agreed in advance
practical: Some streets are busy with traffic: the guide chooses the safest route.
notes: Confirm whether €100 is per group, the route and whether the tour is always three hours.
The line about traffic in practical notes is our suggestion: confirm or remove.

seoDescription: Three-hour walk through modern Mostar with a local guide: 20th-century architecture, Street Art Festival murals and the city’s reconstruction.
